name: Eaton Corporation plc

investment_theses.company_type: Electrical Infrastructure / Powering New US Industrial Capacity

content: Eaton Corporation plc is a multinational power management company that provides energy-efficient solutions to help customers effectively manage electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical power. The company operates through various segments, including Electrical Americas, Electrical Global, Aerospace, and Vehicle, serving diverse markets such as data centers, utilities, industrial, and residential. Eaton is dedicated to improving the quality of life and the environment through the use of power management technologies and services, focusing on sustainability and innovation to address the world's most urgent power management challenges.

tabs.label: Management
tabs.content:
Officers

Craig Arnold(Date: 2016 June)

Chairman and Chief Executive Officer

Craig Arnold is Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Eaton. He was appointed Chairman and CEO on June 1, 2016. Previously, he served as President and Chief Operating Officer of Eaton and as Vice Chairman and Chief Operating Officer of the Industrial Sector. He joined Eaton in 2000 as Senior Vice President and Group Executive of the Fluid Power Group. Prior to Eaton, he held various leadership positions at General Electric.

Olivier Leonetti(Date: 2024 February)

Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer

Olivier Leonetti is Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Eaton. He joined Eaton in 2024. Prior to joining Eaton, he served as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Johnson Controls International plc from 2020 to 2024. He also served as CFO of Zebra Technologies and Western Digital.

Heath Monesmith(Date: 2022 July)

President and Chief Operating Officer, Electrical Sector

Heath Monesmith is President and Chief Operating Officer, Electrical Sector. He was appointed to this role in 2022. Previously, he served as President and Chief Operating Officer, Industrial Sector, and as Executive Vice President and General Counsel.

Paulo Ruiz(Date: 2022 July)

President and Chief Operating Officer, Industrial Sector

Paulo Ruiz is President and Chief Operating Officer, Industrial Sector. He was appointed to this role in 2022. He joined Eaton in 2019 as President of the Hydraulics Group. Prior to Eaton, he spent more than 18 years with Siemens.

Ernest W. Marshall, Jr.(Date: 2018 July)

Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer

Ernest W. Marshall, Jr. is Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer. He joined Eaton in 2018. Prior to Eaton, he served in various HR leadership roles at GE Aviation.

Directors

Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Eaton since 2016. Joined Eaton in 2000.

Independent Director

Executive Chairman of the Board of Directors of Schindler Holding Ltd. since 2017. He has held various leadership roles at Schindler since 1994.

Retired Senior Vice President, Flight Operations, Continental Airlines, Inc. She served in this role from 1999 until 2005.

Gregory R. Page(Date: 2003 January)

Lead Director

Retired Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Cargill, Incorporated. He served as Executive Chairman from 2013 to 2015 and CEO from 2007 to 2013.

Dorothy C. Thompson(Date: 2016 January)

Independent Director

Retired Chief Executive Officer of Drax Group plc. She served as CEO from 2005 to 2017.

Lori J. Ryerkerk(Date: 2020 January)

Independent Director

Chairman, Chief Executive Officer and President of Celanese Corporation since 2019. Previously Executive Vice President of Global Manufacturing, Shell Downstream Inc.

Robert J. Pagano, Jr.(Date: 2023 January)

Independent Director

President, Chief Executive Officer and Chairperson of the Board of Watts Water Technologies, Inc. since 2014.
